question: Carry-back test once the 2026 CRA 'List of charities' release is published: for the 9 DAF sponsors not covered by filed excesses (Brandon University Foundation, Fondation du College de l'Assomption, Bierer Foundation, Lithuanian Canadian Foundation, Fredericton CF, Fondation Pointe-a-Calliere, Caritas-Sherbrooke, Rogan Foundation, Catholic Foundation of Manitoba), check whether a FY2026 line 865 excess covers the FY2025 shortfall under ITA s.149.1(20) (one year back), and rerun scripts/mission_canada_carry_forward.py with the 2026 release as target
conclusion_affected: Whether Canadian DAF sponsor DQ shortfalls are temporary (timing) or persistent; count of uncovered sponsors (4 to 9 of 22)
rationale: CKAN search on 2026-11-20 lists 'List of charities' datasets for 1990-2025 only, so carry-backs could not be tested; 9 of 22 are uncovered on filed data (C$1.81m)

question: Brandon University Foundation (BN 889535449RR0001) line 5900: its 2020 and 2021 returns report C$2.41m and C$2.54m against C$74.2m (2022) and C$73.3m (2023 Schedule 8 line 805) with total assets of C$73-81m. Verify the true 2020-2021 average property from the foundation's own published financial statements or the CRA charity listing pages, and recompute its pre-2023 excess
conclusion_affected: Uncovered shortfall dollars: C$1.13m (screened) vs C$0.22m (unscreened); Brandon is 37% of the C$2.49m total shortfall
rationale: Brandon's pre-2023 proxy pool (C$5.5m unscreened) comes almost entirely from the two implausible years; the screen removes them and leaves Brandon uncovered in all three filed years (2023-2025 shortfalls C$0.26m, C$0.90m, C$0.91m)

question: CRA guidance on disbursement excess: when www.canada.ca is reachable, read the CRA DQ calculation guidance and T4033 guide (2023+) to confirm (a) whether an excess earned under the pre-2023 3.5% DQ carries forward unchanged into post-2023 years and (b) whether a year with a nil DQ (line 5850 = N) produces an excess equal to all qualifying spending under s.149.1(21)
conclusion_affected: 5 of 16 'covered' verdicts depend on these readings (3 old-rate proxy rescues: Fredericton, Assomption, Bierer; 2 nil-DQ: St. Kevin's Parish, Pemberton)
rationale: The verdicts rest on the statutory text only (ITA s.149.1(20)-(21), current and 2022-11-17 versions); CRA administrative practice was not read because www.canada.ca was unreachable in earlier passes

question: Panel-wide benchmark: run the same Schedule 8 chain (2023-2025 releases, FIFO pool) for every charity in 2025 shortfall, not just DAF sponsors, to measure what share of all charity DQ shortfalls is covered by filed carry-forwards, and compare with the 13 of 22 (C$0.66m of C$2.49m) found for DAF sponsors
conclusion_affected: Whether DAF sponsors are more or less often in uncovered DQ shortfall than other charities
rationale: The 2025 Schedule 8 file has 14,852 rows and the 2024 file 14,631; only the 22 DAF sponsors were chained here, so there is no base rate to say whether 9 uncovered of 22 is unusual

question: Schedule 8 filing consistency: count 2023-2025 Schedule 8 rows where line 865 differs from line 860 minus line 840 (e.g. Caritas-Sherbrooke 2025: 865 = +27,485 with spending below DQ; Northside/Harbourview 2024: 840 blank and 865 = 860), and flag rows where 840 is blank, to size how far filed line 865 can be trusted as the carry-forward input
conclusion_affected: Reliability of any line-865-based carry-forward or shortfall count (parent doc's 10 of 22; this pass's 11-13 of 22)
rationale: Two of 55 filed Schedule 8 chain rows for the 22 sponsors have an 865 inconsistent with 860 - 840; the share across all charities is unknown

question: Fill unknown pre-2023 years: line 5900 is blank on 10 pre-v27 returns of the shortfall sponsors (Pemberton 2020-2023, Cowichan 2021-2023, Catholic Foundation of Manitoba 2022-2023, Barrie 2020) and spending lines on 2 (Bierer 2021, Caritas 2020). Check whether these were Section D filers (property below the C$25k/C$100k threshold, i.e. nil DQ) from the release's Section Used field and published financial statements
conclusion_affected: Catholic Foundation of Manitoba (C$3.0k uncovered) and Caritas-Sherbrooke (C$12.4k uncovered) could move from PARTLY_COVERED to COVERED
rationale: Unknown years are treated as contributing nothing; if those were nil-DQ years their spending would be a disbursement excess
